decision_umm_umw: Quaternius Ultimate Modular Men/Women are used as DISTINCT BASES (each pack = one family: one CTS skeleton, one shared atlas/material, every head/top/bottom/feet part swaps inside the family). Not refitted onto UBC bodies: refitting would bring back two faces for the whole cast and needs garment re-modelling between very different body proportions. Evidence: style test + proportion overlay (cast-hermes-20261010/style_test_sheet.jpg).

budgets.accessory_rule: Hero and LOD0 show every selected accessory (selection must fit the caps); LOD1 keeps accessories in selection order while the character stays within the LOD1 cap; LOD2 shows none.
budgets.scope: per complete visible character incl. accessories; compose() reports over_budget and accessories_dropped

palettes.skin_method: Equal CIEDE2000 steps along a CIELAB skin locus (L* 88 -> 24); sRGB D65.
palettes.brows: derived from hair: same hue, linear luminance min(0.55 x hair, 0.075), 60 % saturation (v3_common.brow_color)

tint_resolution: modular families: tints = default_tints of the selected parts (feet, bottom, top, head order) <- base look_defaults <- user tints; brows = brow_color(final hair) unless the user sets brows. UBC/heroes: base look_defaults <- user tints.
tint_formula: sequential per region: out = lerp(out, tint * min(luminance(out) / max(0.03, luminance(tint_reference[region])), 1.6), mask); luminance in linear light; masks non-colour; family atlases store tintable texels as shade x #9a9a9a so every part of a family re-colours identically
